sections.title: 2. Why does it happen?
sections.body:
- No shared task registry.
- No task ownership.
- Poor task decomposition.
- Supervisor assigns overlapping tasks.
- Agents cannot see completed work.
- Retry mechanisms create duplicate jobs.
- Parallel execution lacks deduplication.

sections.title: 6. How to fix it?
sections.body:
**Solution 1 — Task registry**

Maintain a central record of all tasks and their owners.

```python
task_registry = {
    "task_101": {
        "description": "Research OpenAI",
        "assigned_to": "agent_1",
        "status": "completed"
    },
    "task_102": {
        "description": "Research Anthropic",
        "assigned_to": "agent_2",
        "status": "running"
    }
}
```

**Solution 2 — Task ownership**

Each task should have one clearly defined owner unless intentional collaboration is required.

**Solution 3 — Deduplication**

Use task fingerprints or unique IDs to prevent accidental duplicate submissions.

**Solution 4 — Shared results**

Store completed task outputs so other agents can reuse them.

**Solution 5 — Cost controls**

Set per-task and per-workflow budgets.

**Memory trick:**

> Duplicate work = Multiple agents do the same job unnecessarily.

> Duplicate work = Multiple agents do the same job unnecessarily.

- Solution 1 — Task registry Maintain a central record of all tasks and their owners.
- Solution 2 — Task ownership Each task should have one clearly defined owner unless intentional collaboration is required.
- Solution 3 — Deduplication Use task fingerprints or unique IDs to prevent accidental duplicate submissions.
- Solution 4 — Shared results Store completed task outputs so other agents can reuse them.
- Solution 5 — Cost controls Set per-task and per-workflow budgets.
- Memory trick: Duplicate work = Multiple agents do the same job unnecessarily.
